headline: Names a postal facility in Pine Lake, Georgia, the "Francis Manuel Ortega Post Office."
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 4567 Rockbridge Road in Pine Lake, Georgia. The building will now be officially called the "Francis Manuel Ortega Post Office." It does not change how mail is handled or any services offered there.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on June 13, 2016, and the name applies from that date.
